description: This Java class defines various constants used throughout the Hono project, including AMQP symbols, protocol types, service names, headers, and utility methods for handling user and connection properties.

classes.name: Constants
classes.description: A final class containing static constants and utility methods for managing properties, headers, symbols, service names, and related utility functions used throughout the Hono project.

methods.name: getClientPrincipal
methods.description: Retrieves the HonoUser principal from a Record or ProtonConnection, defaulting to anonymous if not set.

methods.name: setClientPrincipal
methods.description: Associates a HonoUser principal with a ProtonConnection.

methods.name: copyProperties
methods.description: Copies the connection ID property from a ProtonConnection to a ProtonLink's attachments.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Retrieves the connection ID from a link or connection attachments.

methods.name: setConnectionId
methods.description: Sets the connection ID on a ProtonConnection's attachments.

methods.name: isDefaultTenant
methods.description: Checks if a given tenant ID equals the default tenant identifier.
